verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows that Puzzle versions, reviews, or rolls back its automations, such as custom categorization rules or AI Close agents. The closest items do not qualify. The "reviewed by you before anything's final" claim is an approval step on automation outputs, not version control of the automations themselves. Reversing journal entries applies to manual entries, and API URL versioning covers the API, not user automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
